items.title: Brunies Brother Band Interview, 1957-10-19
items.q: Uh, Raleigh the Foe. Yeah, I know him.

ctx.x: Who were some of the other fellas you were with in Chicago when you made the records? Well... I don't remember that.

I believe I got them in that scrapbook. Oh, that's real. We'll still find all that. Look it up, sir. I got a picture of my whole band in this scrapbook. Oh, that's good, yeah. But I don't believe the names are in there. Well, we'll check with you. Well, now, my drummer was Bill Paley. Bill Paley, you want to put it down? Yeah, and we'll have it on the tape here anyway. We'll have it, yeah. We've got it on the tape, don't we? Bill Paley was my drummer. Norman Vanhoek was my bass man. Sousaphone. Maury Friedman was…
